                                                     REGULAR MEETING of the Willow Bay City Council
                                                           Wednesday, February 18, 2026: 6:30 p.m.
                                                                            Willow Bay City Council Chambers
                                                                         Heron Avenue, Willow Bay

                            Dana Ruiz, Mayor                       Omar Hale, Vice Mayor
            Lee Tran                              Ana Brook                              Sam Ito

 Teleconference Information:
 The Willow Bay City Council offers teleconference participation in the meeting as a courtesy to the public.

 Submit public comment by:
 1. Emailing clerk@willowbay.example prior to 5:00 P.M. on the day of the meeting,
 2. Attending the meeting in-person at the Council Chambers on Heron Avenue
 3. Selecting the “Raise Hand” icon in the online meeting.
